title: Breeze Plasma busy indicator graphic looks kind of weird when it's not animating because animations have been globally disabled
line: With animations turned off, Plasma's busy spinner now shows a circular arrow instead of a still broken ring.
explanation: PlasmaComponents BusyIndicator just stops rotating the Breeze busywidget graphic when animations are disabled. That graphic is a ring with a gap and a tapering tail that only reads as "busy" while it spins, so frozen it looks like a broken circle (in the tray, Networks, Bluetooth, task manager launch feedback). The Breeze busywidget.svg gains a static variant (busywidget-static, plus 22-22 and 16-16 sizes) drawn as a circular arrow, and BusyIndicator uses it when animations are off and the theme provides it; other themes keep their usual graphic.

commits.message:
BusyIndicator: show a circular arrow when animations are disabled

With animations disabled the busy indicator stops rotating and is left
as a plain broken ring that doesn't read as busy. Breeze now has a
static variant with an arrowhead, shown when animations are turned off.

BUG: 522294

media.caption: Animations off, busy indicators at 16, 22, 32, 64 and 128 px: a still, broken ring
Same window with the fix: a circular arrow at every size
Notifications tray icon during a file job, animations off
Same tray icon with the fix

review.text: Uses an optional busywidget-static theme element when animations are off, mirroring the existing longDuration check, so third-party themes and the animated spinner are untouched. Minimal QML change plus SVG addition; before/after shots show the frozen broken ring replaced by a circular arrow at all sizes.
